description: React component for displaying detailed network resource information in a trace viewer, including headers, payload, and response content with support for images and fonts.

classes.name: RequestBody
classes.description: Type alias for request body object containing text and optional mimeType.

classes.name: CopyDropdown
classes.description: Component providing dropdown menu for copying network request in various formats.

classes.name: ExpandableSection
classes.description: Component for expandable sections with optional data table and children.

classes.name: HeadersTab
classes.description: Component displaying headers and general info of network resource.

classes.name: PayloadTab
classes.description: Component displaying request payload and query parameters.

classes.name: ResponseTab
classes.description: Component displaying response content, including images, fonts, or text.

classes.name: FontPreview
classes.description: Component rendering a font preview or error message.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: formatBody
methods.description: Formats response body based on content type, with JSON pretty-printing and URL decoding.
